coverage.value: site:onemissionsociety.org missionaries/detail "1" OR "2" OR "3" suffix collision

needs_review.finding: Search results returned ~10 items per query but OMS appears to have ~300 total missionaries. Could not access pagination or deeper pages due to search-result-only constraints.
needs_review.evidence: OMS states ~300 missionaries total; 187 already held; my findings represent 27 new records (or 28 with collision variants) which suggests significant coverage remains
needs_review.recommendation: Future waves could rotate on additional qualifiers (specific regions, programme sub-categories, specific years of service, or additional collision suffix patterns beyond 1/2/3)

needs_review.finding: Located collision variants with suffixes 1, 2, 3 for Long, Freed, Nelson, Taylor, Kappler, Williamson; pattern indicates more suffixes may exist (e.g., Brabon1 was already known, Long has 1 and 3, suggesting possibility of 2)
needs_review.evidence: BRIEF notes: 'numeric suffix on collision (Brabon1, Smith1, Long1/Long3/Long4, Skinner2, Kappler2, McFall2, williamson2, freed2, nelson2, marshall1, duhrkoop1, biddulph2, Taylor2)' shows Long has 1/3/4, not 2 visible in current set
needs_review.recommendation: Next wave could explicitly search for Long2, Long4 and other suffix permutations (Smith2-4, Skinner1/3, etc.) as these gaps suggest data exists

needs_review.finding: Found two inverted-form URLs (fredickson-avery and fey-kristina, schrowang-jesse) matching BRIEF pattern (e.g., conner-allen, douti-claude, leadingham-dana, richardson-philip-and-fiona)
needs_review.evidence: BRIEF explicitly lists 'occasional inverted forms' but only found 3 in current search set; existing excluded list does not contain fredickson, fey, or schrowang, but does contain some inverted originals
needs_review.recommendation: Future searches could specifically target first-name-led inversions to find remaining records in this pattern (e.g., site: +inverted forms)

needs_review.finding: Cannot verify tier, giving status, or full biographical detail without opening actual pages; classification as 'Tier A' and 'personal_page' is inferred from URL pattern matching BRIEF specifications, not from page content
needs_review.evidence: BRIEF states 'Page fetching is BLOCKED'; URLs follow confirmed pattern but evidence_basis relies on search title+URL combination, not page inspection
needs_review.recommendation: Ingest should verify tier and support status by reviewing actual pages; all 27 records carry 'high' confidence due to URL+title matching, not page content
